thread:
Nina: Quick plan  Need a one-pager + field post for Secure Deploy (VPC/on-prem). Focus: SLAs, inbound lead routing, benchmark headline, webinar CTA. Short and field-ready.

Omar: Ill do the AE one-pager and 3 qualifying questions.

Leah: Ill pull the benchmark numbers and draft a 2-sentence narrative. Use the latest quantized L2-13b csv.

ProductBot: benchmark file uploaded -> s3://redwood-inference/benchmarks/rdw-l2-13b-2026-03.csv :white_check_mark:

Nina: Routing fields for the HubSpot form: `deployment_choice`, `compliance_needs`, `data_residency_region`, `priority_sla`. Those map to AE queues.

Omar: Routing rule draft: if `deployment_choice`=="Private" OR `compliance_needs` contains "HIPAA" -> route to Enterprise AE queue; if `priority_sla` -> tag `urgent` and notify SEs.

Leah: Benchmark blurb: "Dedicated shows ~2x sustained throughput vs Hosted and ~1.4x lower cost per token for high-volume, steady workloads (quantized L2-13b)." Will add footnote with test conditions.

Nina: Webinar CTA: "Join our Secure Deploy workshop  demo + Q&A". Pick Wed 9am PT or Thu 1pm PT. Field prefers Wed.

Omar: I'll draft the cheat-sheet and share by EOD tomorrow. Leah  please include the stat table (p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens) in the one-pager.

Nina: Great. Owners: Omar=AE cheat-sheet + routing doc, Leah=bench blurb + stat table, Nina=launch post + webinar RSVP. Review planned tomorrow 10:30am PT. :calendar:
